overview: Holding an informational session due to the lack of a quorum, the commission discussed member recruitment, state automated traffic enforcement proposals, and a WalkMedford letter regarding state roadways. Members also reviewed municipal updates on planned bike lanes, signal detection improvements, and bike rack grants.

items.title: Call to Order and Quorum
items.summary: The commission called the meeting to order and determined that no quorum was present, proceeding as an informational meeting.

items.title: Board Member Recruitment
items.summary: Chair Daniel Nuzzo-Mueller reported that the commission is seeking four to five new members and is coordinating with the city to review submitted applications.

items.title: Secretary Vacancy
items.summary: Bruce Kulik agreed to act as secretary pro tem for administrative duties while members share note-taking responsibilities.

items.title: Automated Speed Enforcement Legislation
items.summary: Members discussed proposed state legislation regarding automated camera enforcement and potential applications for Medford streets and state roadways.

items.title: WalkMedford DCR Letter
items.summary: Nuzzo-Mueller reported signing on as chair to a WalkMedford letter requesting that the mayor advocate with the Department of Conservation and Recreation for safety improvements along state-controlled roads.

items.title: Infrastructure and Staffing Updates
items.summary: Nuzzo-Mueller reviewed city updates regarding bike lane plowing, planned lane markings, signal video detection, delayed bike rack grants, and hiring for the vacant traffic engineer position.
